_doc: Tunable config for the Ollama offload stack (historical name: llm-host offload — the first inference host was llm-host). Multi-host aware as of 2026-07-02: `hosts.<name>` map + `default_host` selects the active inference endpoint. Env overrides win: OLLAMA_HOST picks which host entry to use; OLLAMA_URL / OLLAMA_MODEL / OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_S / OLLAMA_TEMPERATURE / OLLAMA_CONTEXT_TOKENS override individual fields. Legacy LEIRA_URL / LEIRA_MODEL / LEIRA_TIMEOUT_S / LEIRA_TEMPERATURE / LEIRA_CONTEXT_TOKENS still honored for backward compat (deprecated). Input-size caps are DERIVED at runtime from the model's actual context window (learned via /api/show), NOT hardcoded. Values below are RATIOS of context or per-consumer knobs. To force an absolute byte cap on any consumer, use its `*_override` key (e.g. draft.max_input_bytes_override). `think: false` (2026-07-18) — top-level Ollama /api/chat `think` field default; prepass contract is fast structured-JSON extraction, thinking never helps and can silently hang a call for the full timeout (qwen3.6:35b is a reasoning model; runs 21+22 census offload defeated for this reason — see feedback_leira_silent_fallback_wastes_offload). Direct-probe measurement: think=false = 1.5s vs 180s+ silent-hang with no field. Per-call `think=` kwarg on call_leira() still overrides; env OLLAMA_THINK/LEIRA_THINK still wins.

llm-host.notes: Primary GPU host (RTX 3090, 24GB); qwen3.6:35b prefer-loaded per ollama-keepalive cron

defer_sweep._doc: Consumer for scripts/leira_defer_sweep.py — the all-history postponement-language corpus sweep. Ratio 0.30 keeps a batch of ~25 short snippets comfortably under the runtime-discovered context. Batch size is a per-Ollama-call knob (not model-context sized), so it's a plain int here.

push_ci_shepherd._doc: Consumer for the push-ci-shepherd AI development tooling(.the AI assistant/agents/push-ci-shepherd.md). Invoked ONLY when the shepherd needs actual LLM reasoning about a CI failure — the happy path (list + watch + tail-of-log) is deterministic and never touches llm-host. Ratio 0.30 keeps the failing-step log tail comfortably under the runtime-discovered context window.
